wish: someone should make a tool that opens large mbox email files and lets me read them
spec:
Opens an .mbox file of any size on the device, indexing it in 8 MB slices so multi-gigabyte archives never load whole into memory.
Lists every message by sender, date and subject (newest or oldest first), filters as you type, can search inside message text, and opens a message with MIME, encoded headers, HTML-only mail and attachments decoded.
It does not send, reply, edit or upload anything; nothing leaves the page and the file is only read.
